sloka: न ततर्प समायान्तं पश्यमानो नराधिपः ।अवतार्य सुमन्त्रस्तं राघवं स्यन्दनोत्तमात् ॥२-३-३०॥
transliteration: na tatarpa samāyāntaṁ paśyamāno narādhipaḥ ।avatārya sumantrastaṁ rāghavaṁ syandanottamāt ॥2-3-30॥

translations.english: ﻿ Sumantra assisted Rama while alighting from that splendid chariot and followed him with folded palms as Rama was proceeding towards his father.
